method: Production Kotlin MeshTransport and MeshConfig on JVM; fake JNI instance manager preserves pinned upstream name/retain-set semantics; real loopback TLS listeners and certificate verification.
cases: Distinct private network codes and unique named native instances coexist with separate loopback ports
Same host display name does not merge private network identities
Stop A preserves B route and real TLS handshake
Partial native startup failure C retains B
Restart A then close B preserves A
Concurrent registry starts/releases retain exact surviving instance names
Failed native cleanup retries on next start while preserving other owners
Cancelled/invalid/duplicate startup does not remove other owners
compiler: Kotlin 2.0.20 embedded in Gradle 8.11.1; JVM target 17
limitations: No Android hardware or public relay connectivity exercised
Native FFI is a deterministic test double; original ABI and native source remain unchanged
